lead: Dr. Puneeth Rajkumar was an Indian actor, born on 17 March 1974 in Chennai.
He died on 29 October 2021 in Bengaluru at the age of 47.
He has 45 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the Filmfare Awards South.
The sections that follow break down Dr. Puneeth Rajkumar's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Dr. Puneeth Rajkumar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Dr. Puneeth Rajkumar was born on 17 March 1974 in Chennai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Dr. Rajkumar and his mother, Parvathamma Rajkumar. He is a sibling of Raghavendra Rajkumar and Shiva Rajkumar.
He is recorded as speaking Kannada.
